summary: Amdocs Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and presentation for its fiscal Q2 2026 earnings. Revenue was $1.17B (up 3.9% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS $1.28, non-GAAP $1.78. The CFO Tamar Rapaport-Dagim announced retirement with Tal Rozenfeld appointed as successor effective June 1, 2026. This is a routine earnings report with a planned CFO succession; no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review exists. The registrant is the issuer reporting financial results and a leadership transition that is neither forced nor abrupt.
